description: This file defines the static class 'TestDefaultConfiguration' which centralizes configuration management for testing environments in Orleans-based projects. It includes loading configuration settings from environment variables, JSON files, and in-memory collections, as well as providing accessors for various connection strings and credentials used during testing.

classes.name: SerializablePhysicalFileProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of IFileProvider that serializes PhysicalFileProvider using JSON for test configuration purposes.

methods.name: InitializeDefaults
methods.description: Initializes the default configuration by building it with the BuildDefaultConfiguration method.

methods.name: UseAadAuthentication
methods.description: Property that returns a boolean indicating whether Azure Active Directory authentication should be used, parsed from the configuration.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value for a given key.

methods.name: BuildDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Constructs and returns the default IConfiguration object, combining environment variables, JSON files, and in-memory collections.

methods.name: ConfigureHostConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the IConfigurationBuilder with environment variables, JSON files, and default settings such as ZooKeeper connection string.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileInAncestorFolder
methods.description: Searches ancestor folders for a specified JSON config file and adds it to the configuration builder if found.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileFromEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Attempts to add a JSON config file specified by an environment variable path to the configuration builder.
